name: The Heritage Blazer
description: Impeccably tailored from Georgian wool. A silhouette that speaks before you do.
details: 100% Georgian Highland Wool. Handcrafted in Batumi. Silk-lined interior with gold-stamped monogram. Horn buttons sourced from the Caucasus.

name: The Caucasus Overcoat
description: Eight thousand years of heritage, woven into every thread.
details: Italian cashmere-wool blend. Full canvas construction. Hand-stitched lapels. Concealed horn buttons. Unlined sleeves for natural drape.

name: The Colchis Shirt
description: Whisper-weight cotton. Precision in every stitch.
details: Egyptian cotton, 140 thread count. Mother-of-pearl buttons. French cuffs. Reinforced collar stays. Handmade in Batumi.

name: The Batumi Trousers
description: Tailored for those who move with purpose.
details: Wool-linen blend. Half-lined. Extended waistband with side adjusters. No belt loops by design. Hand-finished hems.

name: The Silk Cravat
description: A subtle declaration. Hand-rolled edges. Georgian silk.
details: 100% mulberry silk. Hand-rolled edges. Gold-thread OM monogram. Presented in a handcrafted wooden box.

name: The Timekeeper Cufflinks
description: Forged in gold. Engraved by hand. Worn by the discerning.
details: 18K gold-plated brass. Hand-engraved Georgian motif. T-bar closure. Presented in leather case with certificate of authenticity.
